description: Patch-automerge is on: Vector is a stateless stream processor with no schema or data migrations, and all 35 of its upstream upgrade guides target a 0.X.0 minor release - not one patch release has ever had one. The Molecule scenario deploys the bumped image tag, asserts the running binary reports vector_version, and pushes an event through a source, a transform and a sink.

The extractVersion rule below is what makes any update appear at all: timberio/vector publishes no plain X.Y.Z tag whatsoever, only distribution-flavoured ones, so the pinned 0.56.0 did not exist in the namespace Renovate searched and this role was never bumped. The rule is tied to vector_container_image_distribution's `debian` default; changing that default means changing the rule too.

packageRules.description: Read versions out of the `-debian` tags that vector_container_image_tag composes, ignoring the other distribution flavours, the `nightly-*` builds and the `X.Y.Z.custom.<sha>-*` ones
